the demo.

All fourteen catalogue artists and release identities are fictional. The twenty-one recordings below are real music by Kevin MacLeod, used under CC BY 4.0. Fifteen full recordings accompany the five new artist editions; the six earlier licensed releases use sequential chapters. Their licence applies independently of the prototype’s simulated ownership controls. These credits and downloads are available to everyone.
